title: Dirt Composting
description: This mod allows you to compost dirt items into bone meal!
body:
## Don't throw away dirt, compost it!

This mod allows you to compost dirt and other items with little use and often aren't used!

### Compost list:
Dirt: 30% chance

Coarse Dirt: 45% chance

Rooted Dirt: 35% chance

Grass Block: 40% chance

Podzol: 40% chance

Farmland: 45%

Dirt Path: 50%

Mycelium: 65%

Mud: 45%

Muddy Mangrove Roots: 50%
